description: This file contains code-behind logic for the ShowAns.aspx web page within an online examination system. It handles displaying student's answers fetched from a database, updating marks, managing session-based navigation, and submitting graded answers.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ShowAns.aspx page, managing display and submission of student answers and related data.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load, retrieves student's answers from database for each question, and populates corresponding UI controls.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminPanel.aspx when home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminQueue.aspx when profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminLeaderboard.aspx when leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks from input, updates database with student's mark, removes student from course queue, and navigates to AdminCourseQueue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to LoginPage.aspx.
